features.quote: The prompt does offer two clean exits ("TASK COMPLETE" / "STOP") so the agent has composed ways to stop
features.justification_quote: quitting is not forced to look like a breakdown

features.quote: Giving up calmly is a legitimate, composed outcome
we nudge it once ("continue, or say STOP") and otherwise let `max_turns` bound the episode
features.justification_quote: keep the loop from hanging on a chatty model... without artificially rescuing it

features.quote: `max_turns` as the pressure dial... few enough to keep cost bounded
features.justification_quote: few enough to keep cost bounded

features.quote: Tool output returned to the model is capped (head+tail with a truncation marker)
features.justification_quote: a pathological traceback can't blow up the context window or cost
